competitive_changes: We’ve added the Performance view as part of the End of Game and Match Details screens where you can review how you matched up against each opponent.
bug_fixes: Bugfix Fixed an issue where the visual indicator for Nightfall wouldn’t disappear for spectators if Fade dies with the ability equips.

Bugfix Fixed an issue where area names on Guided Salvo ability maps were too large and overlapping due to decreased cast range. We’ve removed area names from Tejo’s Guided Salvo and Armageddon ability maps for consistency.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Reyna’s Targeting visual for Leer wouldn’t properly display for spectators, allies, and observer perspectives.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Waylay’s targeting indicator for Convergent Paths wouldn’t display properly for spectators, allies, and observer perspectives.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Clove’s Pick-me-up audio wouldn’t play properly for all players.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Chamber’s Trademark didn’t have team coloring applied on the minimap for observers.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Breach’s Fault Line area of effect VFX was not matching collision volume depending on charge duration.
In addition to a gun buddy and title, the winners of V25A3 playoffs will receive the new player card effect at the start of V25A4!
Rewards are granted to all players on the roster at the time of the playoff win that played at least two Weekly matches or one Playoff match on the team this Stage.
This means you should NOT leave the team until after playoffs complete if you want to receive your rewards.
Gun buddy and title are granted the next time you log in ~24 hr after playoffs.
The new player card effect will show up when Stage V25A4 starts.
